card.name: Second word after sentence-opening The
card.fires_on: The word right after a sentence- or title-opening "The", such as a noun, superlative or the start of an acronym (marriage, use, largest, best, most). It is weaker on linking words like "that" or "of" after a noun.

modes.label: Word after opening The
modes.description: A noun or superlative directly after a capitalized "The" at the start of a headline or sentence.
modes.example: The<< use>> of animals in medical research became firmly established

modes.label: Start of acronym after The
modes.description: The first letter of an abbreviation after "The".
modes.example: The<< U>>.S. Gulf Coast Braces for Oil

modes.label: Linking word after a noun
modes.description: A weaker case where "that" or "of" follows a noun early in the sentence.
modes.example: The record<< of>> an Ethiopian eunuch and Philip meeting

card.plain: It fires on the second word of a sentence that opens with "The", where the subject noun phrase is just starting.
evidence: The<< marriage>> of artificial and bio-materials to create
The<< best>> way to learn vocabulary is through a set
The<< most>> characteristic and comprehensive theme in all American history
